notes.title: Spread the word! Bacon Tales to release october 12th
notes.notes:
Our new game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/508200/Bacon_Tales__Between_Pigs_and_Wolves/]Bacon Tales - Between Pigs and Wolves[/url] will be released on october 12th!! Support us at our Thunderclap campaing to spread the word!

It's simple and at no costs, just a few clicks to join the campaing!

[olist]
[*]Visit our [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/63002-bacon-tales-steam-release]Thunderclap campaing page[/url]
[*]Click on ADD MY SUPPORT
[*]Choose witch social media to join the campaing
[*]DONE!!!
[/olist]

Be a part of it!! Spread the word!!!

notes.title: New Update - v2.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi guys! How are you today?

We were very busy working on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/508200/Bacon_Tales__Between_Pigs_and_Wolves/]Bacon Tales: Between Pigs and Wolves[/url] release, so, please forgive us!

Queen of Seas has a new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v2.0.4
-=-=-=-=-=-

- BUG Fixed: Coin achievements are now triggering (hope so, it worked in tests. Visit "Achievements" on main menu, if the achievement is triggered in-game, just restart game client and it will trigger on Steam too).
- Fixed command delay.

-=-=-=-=-=-


Please, report any other bugs in comments below.

Visit our new game [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/508200/Bacon_Tales__Between_Pigs_and_Wolves/]Bacon Tales: Between Pigs and Wolves[/url] Steam page.

notes.title: New Update - v2.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi guys! How are you today?

Queen of Seas has a (good) new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v2.0.2
-=-=-=-=-=-

- Full art rework - All old sprites and backgrounds were replaced by new ones.
- New original chiptune album - Total 8 tracks (5 new), 18 minutes lenght.

- "Enter" key at upgrade scene will start level scene (don't need to use mouse click).

-=-=-=-=-=-

We hope you enjoy the new art style!

Next updates: 

* Story rework and eBook
* Language change option

notes.title: New Update - v2.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi guys! How are you today?

Queen of Seas has a new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v2.0.1
-=-=-=-=-=-

- Controller support added.
- Steam Achievements added.

-=-=-=-=-=-

It was needed to change some core mechanics due deprecated scripts, please report any possible bugs.

We are already working in a new update (maybe the last one for this game), possible changes includes: complete art rework, language change option (EN_US, PT_BR and YO_NG) and more original chiptunes songs.

Stay tunned!!!
